# Build the future of cloud with us

Working at Cast AI means pushing your limits, learning fast, and seeing your impact. We’re building the future of cloud – and investing in yours.

[View open roles](https://cast.ai/careers/#open-positions)

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/career-hero-1024x922.jpg)

Values

## Our core values

We apply our foundational values in every aspect of our work – from hiring to decision-making, execution, and feedback. These principles unite our teams, fuel fearless innovation, and drive real change in the cloud industry.

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-value-change.svg)

### Expect and advocate change

Strive to innovate and accept the inevitable change that comes with innovation. Constantly welcome new ideas and opinions. Share insights responsibly with unwavering openness, honesty, and respect. Once a path is chosen, be ready to disagree and commit to a direction.

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-value-lead.svg)

### Lead

Take ownership and lead through action. Think and act on behalf of the entire company to build long-term value across team boundaries.

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-value-develop.svg)

### Develop and hire the best

Strive to raise the performance bar by continuously investing in yourself, the team and by hiring the best possible candidates for every position. Drive towards personal development and professional growth, and mentor others to raise the collective bar.

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-value-obsession.svg)

### Practice customer obsession

Focus on the customer journey and work backwards. Strive to deliver customer value and continuously solve customer problems. Listen to customer feedback, act, and iterate to improve customer experience.

Benefits

## What we offer at Cast AI

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-remotework.svg)

### Remote work

Enjoy the flexibility of remote-first work. While we have offices, our team is globally distributed, and remote work is fully supported.

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-stockoptions.svg)

### Company stock options

Become a shareholder from day one. We offer stock options to all team members as part of our commitment to shared success.

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-hackathon.svg)

### Annual Hackathon

Innovation is in our DNA. Join our global hackathon to collaborate, build, and explore new ideas beyond your usual role.

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-insurance.svg)

### Health insurance

Your well-being matters. We offer comprehensive health coverage and wellness support.

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-flexhours.svg)

### Flexible working hours

Design a work schedule that fits your lifestyle. We trust you to manage your time effectively.

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-office.svg)

### Home office allowance

We help you create a comfortable, productive workspace with a dedicated home office stipend.

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-pdo.svg)

### Bonus days off

Recharge with extra paid time off beyond standard holidays – because work-life balance matters.

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-edubudget.svg)

### Learning & development budget

Invest in yourself. We provide a budget for courses, conferences, and other learning opportunities.

![](https://cast.ai/wp-content/themes/cx/assets/images/icon-teambuilding.svg)

### Company events & team buildings

From local meetups to virtual socials and team retreats, we make time to connect and celebrate.
